mobilebuild.description: Sentry's MobileBuildMCP (formerly XcodeBuildMCP): build, run, test, screenshot and drive iOS simulators headlessly.

xcode.description: Apple's Xcode MCP bridge (Xcode 26.3+). Needs Xcode running with the project open, or Xcode 27's `xcrun mcp-server enable`. Not wired into any stage by default.

maestro.description: Maestro UI testing (inspect screen, run flows, screenshots). Needs Java 17+.

context7.description: Up-to-date library documentation (keyless; set CONTEXT7_API_KEY in args for higher limits).

playwright.description: Microsoft Playwright MCP for web QA, screenshots and landing-page checks. Uses installed Chrome.

revenuecat.description: RevenueCat: products, entitlements, offerings, AI paywalls, push products to the stores.

fal.description: fal.ai: 1,000+ image/video/audio models (Nano Banana, FLUX, Recraft, Veo, Kling …). Paid per run — capped in policy.yaml.

replicate.description: Replicate models via the local server (the hosted one needs browser login).

recraft.description: Recraft: true SVG/vector icons and illustrations, custom styles from references. OAuth: add + log in once (`claude mcp add --scope user --transport http recraft <url> && claude mcp login recraft`).

elevenlabs.description: ElevenLabs: voice-over, sound effects, licensed music for previews and ads.

stitch.description: Google Stitch: fast divergent screen variants and design-system application.

figma.description: Figma: write frames/components/variables to the canvas (use_figma), design-system search, shaders. OAuth: add + log in once (`claude mcp add --scope user --transport http figma <url> && claude mcp login figma`).

mobbin.description: Mobbin: real app screens and flows for UX reference (paid). OAuth.

supabase.description: Supabase (read-only by default; migrations go through the Supabase CLI in the repo).

apify.description: Apify: thousands of scrapers (App Store reviews, Reddit, Product Hunt …) for scouting and validation. Runs are billed.

expo.description: Expo/EAS: builds, workflows, TestFlight crashes, store review replies. OAuth: add + log in once (`claude mcp add --scope user --transport http expo <url> && claude mcp login expo`).

vercel.description: Vercel: projects, deployments, logs. OAuth. (Deploys themselves go through the CLI with VERCEL_TOKEN.)

notion.description: Notion: optional mirror of the idea board and portfolio reports. OAuth.
